package minimal.pkg.abstracts.joinpoints;

import org.lara.interpreter.weaver.interf.*;
import minimal.pkg.MinimalWeaver;
import minimal.pkg.joinpoints.MinimalJoinpoint;
import java.lang.Object;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.IntFunction;

/**
 * Auto-generated abstract class for the {@code root} join point.
 * <p>
 * This class is generated by WeaverGen2 and should not be edited manually.
 */
public abstract class ARoot<Self extends ARoot<Self>> extends MinimalJoinpoint<Self> {

    public ARoot(Object node, MinimalWeaver weaver) {
        super(node, weaver);
    }

    @Override
    public String get_class() {
        return "root";
    }

    @Override
    public boolean getInstanceOfImpl(String joinpointClassname) {
        return "root".equals(joinpointClassname)
            || "joinpoint".equals(joinpointClassname);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    @Override
    protected IntFunction<Self[]> selfTypeArrayFactory() {
        return size -> (Self[]) new ARoot[size];
    }
}
